reviewEvidence.notes: The final independent review approved canonical promotion after the full source review, source-explicit definedTerms correction, case-level retrieval handoff, strict top-three CTE correction, and code-level verification of the production support window, generic ranking, and regression coverage. Implementation evidence is retained at data/processed/review_packages/vm01-retrieval-implementation-review/manifest.json.

exclusions: The 29 VM-01 explicit-reference relationship candidates, which remain pending, review-only, not promoted, and not promotion-eligible
Historical, proposed, or section-local definitions outside the reviewed current 2026 VM-01 chapter package
Any source or chunk outside vm01-definitions
Learner-facing, application, RAG, vector, and Copilot export approval

downstreamEligibility.reason: Canonical source promotion and downstream publication, retrieval-production, or export approval are separate governance decisions.

reviewerRecord.note: The supplied final independent-review disposition records approval but does not provide a reviewer identity; no identity is inferred.

preservation.note: Promotion changes governance metadata only. The 98 source excerpts, definition text, source-text hashes, page citations, IDs, source-explicit aliases, and retrieval-only normalization boundary remain unchanged.
